review.summary: No bugs, regressions, security issues, missing required tests, documentation mismatches, or scope violations were identified in the reviewed committed TASK-057B diff. The implementation prepares validated serializable inputs from a consistent PostgreSQL read snapshot, calculates normal and derived targets without database access, publishes validated detached results transactionally, preserves the synchronous API contract, and adds unit/API plus disposable-PostgreSQL coverage for the required isolation and rollback behavior.
